outcome: For each explicitly referenced CyberAlchemy capability, let its owner declare which artifacts and working state must survive named loss boundaries and preserve their identity, provenance, lifecycle, access boundary, and recovery obligations without transferring meaning ownership to storage tooling.
scope: Classify owner-declared artifact kinds and working state, record provider-neutral durability requirements, keep complete capability coverage visible, and prepare later exact storage bindings and recovery evidence without selecting or implementing a provider.
exclusions: capturing an arbitrary repository directory or implicit filesystem glob
owning or redefining stored source meaning
treating persistence as adoption, acceptance, authority, or conformance
persisting secret values rather than external secret references
selecting a filesystem, database, object store, cloud service, or deployment topology
claiming recovery without an executed exact recovery test
moving private material into a public subsystem
